verdict.rationale: The evidence describes tool-level restriction within the MCP integration (disabling tools by default and enabling specific ones) but there is no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys/credentials themselves (e.g., key-level permission scopes, per-key rate/resource limits, or role-based key generation). Usage tiers (docs-9/16/22) govern account-wide rate limits based on spend, not credential scoping.
